allow: PowerShell(Write-Output "node: $\(node -v\)"; Write-Output "npm: $\(npm -v\)"; Write-Output "node_modules exists: $\(Test-Path node_modules\)"; Write-Output "generated prisma client: $\(Test-Path node_modules\\.prisma\\client\)"; Write-Output ".next exists: $\(Test-Path .next\)"; Write-Output "next installed: $\(Test-Path node_modules\\next\\package.json\)")

PowerShell($u = \(Get-Content .env | Where-Object { $_ -match '^DATABASE_URL=' }\) -replace '^DATABASE_URL=',''; if \($u -match '^\(mongodb\\+srv|mongodb\)://'\) { Write-Output "scheme: $\($Matches[1]\)" }; if \($u -match '@'\) { Write-Output "credentials embedded: YES \(host redacted\)" } else { Write-Output "credentials embedded: NO" }; if \($u -match 'localhost|127\\.0\\.0\\.1'\) { Write-Output "target: LOCALHOST" } else { Write-Output "target: REMOTE" }; if \($u -match 'replicaSet'\) { Write-Output "replicaSet param: present" } else { Write-Output "replicaSet param: absent" })

PowerShell(Select-String -Path 'node_modules\\.prisma\\client\\index.d.ts' -Pattern 'export type \(User|Session|PasswordRecoverySession\) = ' -List | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim\(\) }; Write-Output "--- generated schema vs source ---"; $a=\(Get-FileHash 'node_modules\\.prisma\\client\\schema.prisma'\).Hash; $b=\(Get-FileHash 'prisma\\schema.prisma'\).Hash; Write-Output "generated-copy hash: $a"; Write-Output "source hash:         $b"; Write-Output "identical: $\($a -eq $b\)")
PowerShell(npx prisma validate 2>&1 | Out-String -Width 200; Write-Output "=== exit: $LASTEXITCODE ==="; Write-Output "=== format check ==="; npx prisma format --check 2>&1 | Out-String -Width 200)
PowerShell(Write-Output "=== attempt 1: eslint 9 default \(flat config\) ==="; npx eslint . --ext .ts,.tsx 2>&1 | Out-String -Width 200; Write-Output "=== exit: $LASTEXITCODE ===")
PowerShell(npx next build 2>&1 | Out-String -Width 200; Write-Output "=== exit: $LASTEXITCODE ===")
PowerShell(npx tsc -p tests\\tsconfig.json 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 25; Write-Output "TSC EXIT: $LASTEXITCODE")

PowerShell($u = \(Select-String -Path .env.local -Pattern '^DATABASE_URL=' | Select-Object -First 1\).Line; if \($u\) { if \($u -match 'mongodb\\+srv'\) { "scheme: mongodb+srv \(Atlas\)" } elseif \($u -match 'localhost|127\\.0\\.0\\.1'\) { "scheme: local mongodb" } else { "scheme: other" } } else { "DATABASE_URL not in .env.local" })

PowerShell($u = \(Select-String -Path .env -Pattern '^DATABASE_URL=' | Select-Object -First 1\).Line; if \($u\) { if \($u -match 'mongodb\\+srv'\) { "scheme: mongodb+srv \(Atlas\)" } elseif \($u -match 'localhost|127\\.0\\.0\\.1'\) { "scheme: local mongodb" } else { "scheme: other" } } else { "not found" }; Get-Content .env | ForEach-Object { if \($_ -match '^\([A-Z_]+\)='\) { $matches[1] } })

PowerShell($ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; node -e "const{PrismaClient}=require\('@prisma/client'\);\(async\(\)=>{const p=new PrismaClient\(\);try{const n=await p.user.count\(\);console.log\('DB_OK users='+n\);}catch\(e\){console.log\('DB_FAIL '+e.message.split\('\\n'\)[0]\);}finally{await p.$disconnect\(\);}}\)\(\)" 2>$null)

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File -Path app, components, lib, prisma, types, tests -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Replace\(\(Get-Location\).Path + '\\', ''\) } | Sort-Object)

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Path node_modules\\next\\dist\\docs -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Output "---VERSION---"; \(Get-Content node_modules\\next\\package.json | ConvertFrom-Json\).version)
PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Recurse tests | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName | ForEach-Object { $_.Replace\("$PWD\\", ""\) } | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch "\\.build" })
PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter route.ts app/api | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName | ForEach-Object { $_.Replace\("$PWD\\", ""\) })

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Recurse lib,app,components,types,prisma -File | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object LastWriteTime, @{n='Path';e={$_.FullName.Replace\($PWD.Path + '\\',''\)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize -Wrap | Out-String -Width 200)
PowerShell($c = Get-Content README.md; "TOTAL LINES: $\($c.Count\)"; $c | Select-String -Pattern '^#{1,4} ' | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.LineNumber\): $\($_.Line\)" })

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File "app\\dashboard","components\\media","lib\\media" | Select-Object @{n='Path';e={$_.FullName.Replace\(\(Get-Location\).Path + '\\',''\)}}, @{n='Modified';e={$_.LastWriteTime.ToString\('MM-dd HH:mm'\)}} | Sort-Object Path | Format-Table -AutoSize)
